channel.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu
channel.description: National news and headlines from within or around India with live updates on major breaking events from The Hindu.

item.title: Mamata in Delhi to participate in INDIA bloc meetings, Suvendu takes a dig
item.description: Our target is the Chief Election Commissioner and his full software team, who cheated and betrayed the people, former West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee said

item.title: INDIA bloc announces Odisha bandh on October 8 over new mining law, other issues
item.description: The bloc demanded the repeal of the MMDR Amendment Act, 2026, and the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, after protesters clashed with police near the Chief Minister’s residence

item.title: Activists caution against efforts to revive bauxite mining in Odisha’s Niyamgiri hills
item.description: Vedanta Group chairman Anil Agarwal put out a statement recently that the Niyamgiri bauxite reserve should be reopened for mining and that it would create jobs for the local tribal population

item.title: Rajasthan HC cancels FIR against Independent MLA arrested during local body polls
Rajasthan first State in northern India to complete digital identification of farmers
Highly educated professionals are vulnerable to financial cybercrime, finds IIT-Madras study
item.description: The researchers found that victims were often targeted during periods of stress or life disruption, including illness in the family, retirement, job searches, or workplace pressure

item.title: Terrorist killed in ongoing operation in Kashmir’s Budgam
item.description: A spokesman said a joint search operation was launched by the Army, J&K Police and CRPF in the general area of Korag, Yousmarg, in Budgam “based on specific intelligence input”.

item.title: Temple burgled near Katpadi
item.description: CCTV camera footage on the route was also being analysed to nab the suspects

item.title: BLAs in Delhi bypassed EC’s 10-form daily limit using poll panel’s own portal, data show
item.description: Between September 21 and 27, as many as 1,095 Form 7 objections were filed in Delhi. Data show around 80% were filed by individuals against their own names

item.title: Democracy without choice: how unopposed Maharashtra rural polls silence dissent
Sahil Wakode’s parents seek police protection, allege threat to life and probe
item.description: The parents have accused IIT Bombay Director Prof. Shireesh Kedare and Prof. Suryanarayana Doolla in connection with Wakode’s death.

item.title: CMC organises events to mark World Heart Day
item.description: Ranipet Collector N. Priya Ravichandran was the chief guest

item.title: Change the name of Adi Dravidar Welfare Department, says Krishnasamy
Muthanga verdict: whose death counts?
item.description: Twenty-three years produced a trial, 47 witnesses and a 217-page judgment for Vinod’s death. For Jogi, they produced nothing — not a charge, a witness, or a line of inquiry.

item.title: Mammoth protest at Kittur Chennamma Circle by Sugarcane farmers; Farmers agree for talk at Delhi with Joshi after intervention by MLAs Tenginakai, Patil
item.description: Thousands of sugarcane growers from across Karnataka and neighbouring Maharashtra and Telangana staged a massive protest at Kittur Chennamma Circle in Hubballi on Tuesday, demanding remunerative prices for sugarcane and a revision of the minimum selling price (MSP) of sugar. After appeal by union minister Pralhad Joshi, intervention by local legislators they agree for talks at Delhi, withdraw protest

item.title: Of those deleted in SIR so far, over 71% in ‘absent, shifted or others’ category
item.description: Many of the 9.5 crore names deleted under the ‘absent, shifted or others’ category could potentially be back in the electoral rolls after the SIR process is completed

item.title: Tamil scholar Pudhumanar and A.R. Venkatachalapathy honoured with awards
EC reverts to allowing Form 6 submission without attached declaration in non-SIR States
item.description: While Form 6 is normally used for new voter registrations, during the SIR process, it was also used for re-enlisting those who had been deleted during the enumeration phase. A separate declaration had been added to the physical form regarding the mapping of self or parents with electoral rolls from the period of the previous SIR

item.title: Ministers Aadhav Arjuna, C.T.R. Nirmal Kumar urge Madras High Court to dismiss DMK’s defamation case
item.description: They contend that the political party had not issued prior notices to them as required under Section 80 of the Code of Criminal Procedure

item.title: Nagenthran urges Madurantakam electorate to think about horse trading and then vote
T.N. government proposes memorial for 5 icons on University Union Grounds at Chepet in Chennai, sports teachers object
item.description: The State government plans to build the memorial complex for 5 icons on a portion of the University Union Grounds in Chetpet belonging to the University of Madras

item.title: Major fire engulfs Fort Kochi’s historic Koder House
item.description: Major tragedy was averted as guests and staff were evacuated from the building soon after the flames were spotted

item.title: Local Sena (UBT) leader dies in Thane after firing by unidentified assailants
item.description: Purnekar was the Thane 'vibhag pramukh' or division head of the Uddhav Thackeray-led party, a Sena (UBT) leader said

item.title: Surveillance is not the only privacy issue
item.description: Who is responsible, when a protester is identified by a camera, doxxed by anonymous accounts, and then threatened at home? What happens to privacy when an electoral-roll decision determines whether someone can vote? Which safeguard applies when data gathered by the police is held by a private company?

item.title: R. Veeramani booked for abetting suicide of minor in 2004
item.description: Chennai Police also book third case against the octogenarian businessmen under the POCSO Act

item.title: Congress names candidates for two Graduate MLC seats

item.description: Protesters say water extraction from the Tejaswini is expected to exceed 30 MLD in March and April. They fear it will worsen water scarcity

item.title: At CWC meet, Rahul says Modi told him: ‘When we go, you will come'

item.description: The saffron party, which has historically struggled to make inroads in Punjab, is aggressively pushing its campaign around the drug menace issue to get a foothold in the border State.

item.title: Centre moves Supreme Court to stay hearings on Great Nicobar project
item.description: Centre reiterates in Supreme Court that the petitioner, Meena Gupta, has no locus standi to move court in the matter and the petitions are an abuse of process; Calcutta High Court had rejected this argument in May and paved the way for a final hearing in November

item.title: BJP, SP pick candidates for MLC Graduates’, Teachers’ seats; caste equations in focus
Japan calls on India to fast-track internal process on UNICORN naval radar agreement
item.description: The pact for transfer of technology was signed during Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s India visit in July

item.title: CEC row updates: Reward Gyanesh Kumar with Bharat Ratna for delivering West Bengal to BJP, says Jammu and Kashmir CM Omar Abdullah
item.description: "Padma Bhushan? Why stop there? Give him the Bharat Ratna! One or two years left for the presidential election? Make him the President! Now that he has done so much for the BJP," says Jammu and Kashmir CM Omar Abdullah

item.title: Country has lost its way, but always finds its path back: Murli Manohar Joshi
item.description: From growing trust deficit in Indian politics to the mishandling of the youth protest at Jantar Mantar, BJP veteran Murli Manohar Joshi, in an interview to The Hindu, speaks at length on various burning issues in the country. On the Ayodhya Ram Temple, he holds the government responsible for the temple trust’s functioning and stressed the need for fair elections and public trust in the SIR process

item.title: SIT arrests seventh accused in fake medicine racket; Chennai link under scanner
item.description: SIT probes hospitals that purchased medicines from accused, examines compliance

item.title: 14 arrested, police search for content creators of AI-generated videos that led to Ujjain violence
item.description: The videos spread a rumour that the authorities were demolishing the entire mosque structure, allegedly provoked people to march to the Shahi Masjid and clash with the police

item.title: Days after India-Pakistan sparring at UN, senior Indian official visits Islamabad for SCO planning meet
item.description: First such official visit by Indian delegation since Operation Indoor; Senior External Affair Ministry official leads team at three-day SCO preparatory meeting

item.title: Rahul Gandhi urged to ensure social diversity in Kerala Planning Board
item.description: The memorandum requests that corrective steps be taken to ensure that the constitutional values of social diversity, professional excellence, inclusion and equal opportunity are reflected in the composition of the Planning Board.

item.title: SFI, KSU claim gains in college union polls in Ernakulam
item.description: SFI wins all seats at Maharaja’s College and 13 of 14 at St. Peter’s College; KSU wrests unions from SFI at six colleges, including Cochin College; KSU retains unions at 10 colleges, including Sacred Heart and Sree Sankara College
